name: EPIC 211956503
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 11.1 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,634 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.96 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,940 K at its surface.
